desc: Start your day with the delicious taste of apple and cinnamon by the spoonful. Every bowl of Apple Cinnamon Cheerios brings together first ingredient whole grain oats, plus real cinnamon and bits of apple in every bite. Beyond the great taste, these little Os can help lower cholesterol* as part of a heart healthy diet. *Three grams of soluble fiber daily from whole grain oat foods, like Apple Cinnamon Cheerios cereal, in a diet low in saturated fat and cholesterol, may reduce the risk of heart disease. Apple Cinnamon Cheerios cereal provides .75 grams per serving. Dig into a bowl with milk as a wholesome part of your morning. A serving of this gluten free sweetened whole grain oat cereal provides 20g of whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), a good source of calcium and fiber, and 12 vitamins and minerals, with no artificial flavors and no artificial colors. Beyond a quick and tasty part of breakfast for adults, this cereal makes an easy, gluten free kids snack by the handful. Pack some crispy cereal in a lunch box for a yummy school treat. Or make it an ingredient in your favorite cereal bars recipe. However you enjoy Apple Cinnamon Cheerios, it's a part of General Mills cereals, spreading goodness from tots to grown-ups. Contains one cardboard box of Apple Cinnamon Cheerios, Heart Healthy Gluten Free Breakfast Cereal, Family Size, 19 oz; perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals.
features:
APPLE CINNAMON CHEERIOS: Gluten free sweetened whole grain oat cereal with the taste of apple and real cinnamon; Bits of apple in every bite; First ingredient whole grain oats

CAN HELP LOWER CHOLESTEROL* as part of a heart healthy diet; *3g soluble fiber daily from whole grain oat foods, in a diet low in saturated fat and cholesterol, may reduce the risk of heart disease - Apple Cinnamon Cheerios provides .75g per serving

WHOLE GRAIN GOODNESS: Provides 20g of whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), a good source of calcium and fiber, and 12 vitamins and minerals per serving; No artificial flavors or colors

GLUTEN FREE CEREAL: Pour a bowl with milk for a gluten free part of breakfast; Pack some as gluten free snacks on the go

CONTAINS: One cardboard box of Apple Cinnamon Cheerios, Heart Healthy Gluten Free Breakfast Cereal, Family Size, 19 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Corn Starch, Apple Puree Concentrate, Corn Syrup, Dried Apples, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Refiner's Syrup, Salt, Cinnamon, Trisodium Phosphate. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
